ClickEvent.title: ClickEvent
ClickEvent.description: Immutable record of a visitor click interaction on a tracked portfolio UI element.

targetId.description: Stable identifier of the clicked UI element.

label.description: Human-readable name of the clicked UI element.

category.description: Portfolio section or category of the clicked element.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the click occurred.

/click_events/{eventId}.description: Append-only click analytics events writable by visitors and readable/deletable exclusively by the authenticated portfolio owner.
